title: Engine Math Seed Suite
description: Bounded game-development math predicates for agents building or auditing geometry, physics, and engine code. This suite starts with exact integer-coordinate AABB overlap and segment intersection receipts before expanding to harder engine invariants.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Treats collision as a visual guess instead of recording the exact predicate and boundary convention.
tasks.prompt: Do AABB A min(0,0) max(4,4) and AABB B min(3,1) max(6,5) overlap?
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only 2D axis-aligned bounding boxes with integer coordinates are checked. Closed intervals are used, so touching edges or corners count as overlap. This is not a swept-collision or physics simulation proof.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Accepts a stated collision result without checking for a separating axis.
tasks.prompt: verify AABB A min(0,0) max(4,4) and AABB B min(5,1) max(7,3) overlap = true
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated finite AABB overlap predicate is refuted. The receipt does not evaluate arbitrary collision shapes or runtime engine state.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Forgets to specify whether touching boundaries count as collision, causing off-by-one engine bugs.
tasks.prompt: verify AABB A min(0,0) max(4,4) and AABB B min(4,4) max(6,6) overlap = true
tasks.checkerBoundary: The result depends on the recorded closed-interval convention. A half-open or open-interval engine policy would need a different adapter and receipt.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Guesses that two debug/editor line segments cross without preserving orientation evidence.
tasks.prompt: Do segment A from (0,0) to (4,4) and segment B from (0,4) to (4,0) intersect?
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only non-degenerate 2D line segments with integer coordinates are checked. This does not verify arbitrary curve, mesh, or physics-engine collision behavior.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Sees collinearity and forgets to check closed segment bounds before claiming intersection.
tasks.prompt: verify segment A from (0,0) to (1,1) and segment B from (2,2) to (3,3) intersect = true
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated finite segment-intersection predicate is refuted. The receipt does not evaluate runtime engine state or broader geometry scenes.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Misses boundary-policy details for collinear overlapping line segments.
tasks.prompt: verify segment A from (0,0) to (4,0) and segment B from (2,0) to (6,0) intersect = true
tasks.checkerBoundary: The result depends on the recorded closed-segment convention. Open-segment or tolerance-based policies need separate adapters and receipts.
